text:
According to the **Land Classification** section of the portal, in 2023 land classified as **crops** covered **60.3%** of Punjab's classified land — about **30.5 million acres**. The classification covers 100% of Punjab's land area (~50.6 million acres), so that share applies to the whole province.

Crops was the most widespread land class in Punjab in both 2017 and 2023.
